newsitem.title: USA: Franklin enters pact with Kinpo.
newsitem.headline: Franklin enters pact with Kinpo.

text.p: Franklin Electronic Publishers Inc said on Wednesday it has formed a joint venture corporation with Taiwan's Kinpo Electronics Inc to develop, manufacture and market handheld electronic books for China and other Asian countries.
The companies will work together within the structure of the joint venture -- PACRIM Publishing Ltd, Franklin said.
The first product will be a speaking Chinese-English bilingual dictionary, scheduled for release in October, Franklin said.
Kinpo will manufacture PACRIM's electronic books for distribution through its nine sales offices in China and in Taiwan, Franklin said.
Franklin said it will sell the products in Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, the United States and the rest of the world.
